_about: Public-domain Christopher Sutton (1565?-1629), Canon of Westminster and Lincoln, for the Word Hoard: his three devotional classics, Disce Mori (Learn to Die), Disce Vivere (Learn to Live) and Godly Meditations upon the Sacrament of the Lord's Supper, in the Oxford reprints of 1839-1841. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 89 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

sutton-disce-mori: Disce mori = Learn to die (Oxford : J.H. Parker, 1839)
sutton-disce-vivere: Disce vivere = Learn to live (Oxford : John Henry Parker, 1841)
sutton-godly-meditations: Godly meditations upon the most holy Sacrament of the Lord's Supper (New York : D. Appleton, 1841)

_excluded.sutton-early-printings: the 1600-1662 printings on Internet Archive (Early English Books): the same three works; left for the EEBO first-editions work
